title: agent-crew host capability flags
description: Host capability advertisement. Lives at {STATE_DIR}/capabilities.json. Written by the host adapter's setup.sh; read by core at runtime via the absence contract. additionalProperties is true because each refactor phase adds new flags (e.g., hook_system, interactive_question planned). Missing flags default to false per the absence contract in core/rules/host-capabilities.md.

schema_version.description: Optional. Adapters that predate F4 omit this field.

host.description: Adapter name (e.g., claude, codex, generic). Informational only — invariant 1 forbids gating any code path on this value.

interactive_question_mode.description: Optional adapter-specific mode detail, e.g. codex_plan_mode_conditional.

interactive_question_surface.description: Optional adapter-specific host UI/tool surface name.

interactive_question_fallback.description: Optional fallback renderer used when no native surface is available.
